parameters.description_en:
The WABA account ID, PageId, AccountId<props="intl">, or ServiceId</props>.

- If \`ChannelType\` is \`WHATSAPP\`, pass the WABA account ID. View the WABA account ID on the **WABA Management** page by navigating to **Channel Management** > **Manage**.

- If \`ChannelType\` is not \`WHATSAPP\`, pass the PageId for \`MESSENGER\` or the AccountId for \`INSTAGRAM\`<props="intl">. For \`VIBER\`, pass the ServiceId</props>.
parameters.description_zh:
WABA账号ID/PageId/AccountId<props="intl">/ServiceId</props>。

- 当ChannelType参数为WHATSAPP时，传WABA账号ID。在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)>**管理**>**WABA管理**界面查看WABA账号ID。

- 当ChannelType参数非WHATSAPP时，MESSENGER对应传PageId；INSTAGRAM对应传AccountId<props="intl">；VIBER对应传ServiceId</props>。
